title: Momoi Airi — Happy Birthday!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: song00004_off_f
Airi's birthday
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Welcome to Airi's birthday stream♪

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<It's showtime!>
<Airi, happy birthday!>
<I waited so long for this day!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Look, Airi!
Our fans have been waiting to celebrate your birthday with you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, wow. Thanks for all the thoughtful comments, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we start off with our special segment? Take it away, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! “Let's Bake a Birthday Cake in Real Time!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll be baking a birthday cake for Airi completely from scratch, including the base and everything!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Hey, that sounds awesome!>
<Whoa! A legit birthday cake for Airi!!>
<Airi's a great cook, so this should be easy, right?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, Airi's the star of today's show, so she'll be in a more advisory role as she commentates throughout the process.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<What?! No Airi?!>
<Seriously? No, you'll be fine! You still have Haruka!>
<Don't mix up the salt for sugar, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I won't! I'm gonna check before I even touch them!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Anyway, shall we get started?
Let's do our best, Minori, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (With me advising as I commentate.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: These three will be tasked with baking a birthday standard! A shortcake!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Aside from the stuff that needs to be prepped in the kitchen, you guys should be able to see everything that goes on here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Starting with spreading some flour around! Gently... Don't let it fly anywhere... Tap, tap, tap...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, this is gonna take an eternity if you're that gentle with it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just tap while keeping your other hand steady. Also, you shouldn't hold it so high, or that far from yourself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good catch, Airi.
You can do it, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, I'll keep trying!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, we'll be whipping up the meringue for the cake.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, so... Crack each egg and use one of the shells to hold just the yolk...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, not bad.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I actually practiced doing this beforehand just in case.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you practiced this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho even said, “We've been having some sort of egg dish every night lately.” Is it because you were practicing this technique?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I started having so much fun that I went a little overboard and ended up using every egg we had in our refrigerator...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Oh dear...>
<C'mon Shizuku lol.>
<This is why Shizuku's the best! She never cuts corners!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can already see you doing what you just described.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same. Along with the look on your mom's face after she realized what you've done...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haruka! Shizuku!
I'm all done with the flour.
I'll go get the strawberries ready now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I should use this chance to go warm the butter in the microwave...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I'll start using the hand mixer to make the meringue.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They're actually doing pretty well for themselves. I can't wait to see the finished product!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-It's done!!
Airi's birthday cake!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Whoa! This shortcake looks amazing!>
<The strawberries are so pretty!>
<A++! Nice work, you guys!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. This turned out better than I expected too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree! Alright, Airi, it's time to cut the cake♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This isn't a wedding...
Also, doesn't that sort of imply I'll be cutting the cake with someone?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, the four of us should cut it together! It'll be our way of saying, “Let's do our best!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good idea!
What do you think, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm in!
You three put your hands on top of mine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for going through the trouble of baking an actual birthday cake for me like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And to all our fans who are watching, thanks for always being there to give MORE MORE JUMP! your support.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The four of us are gonna keep doing everything we can to spread hope to all of you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And with that promise in mind... Let's cut this cake!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mmm...! This cake's so good!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it is. I can't believe you made this yourselves, girls.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's so warm, but also sweet and gentle.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. Is it because they all made it while having Airi in their thoughts?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I believe so.
Mmm... This really is delicious♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for sharing this cake with us, girls! We really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This cake also symbolizes our vow to keep spreading hope to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This won't be our first time, but we'd like to say again that we're not gonna give up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
Understood. We'll hold you to your word.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll all be rooting for you girls, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, so please feel free to ask us for help if you ever think you need it♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we take this opportunity to once again wish Airi a happy birthday?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, let's. Happy birthday, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Co.
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Airi! Happy birthday!
I hope you get a chance to use the oven mitts I got you! Alright, Shiho, you're up♪>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Thank you for always being there to look after my sister, Momoi. I'm not sure how I can repay this debt, but please ask me for any help regarding her if you ever need it...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Airi☆
I'm glad you liked the song I wrote for you♪ If you ever need a pick-me-up, just ask and I'll sing for you!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Heya, Airi! How would you feel about us throwing a party for you sometime soon? Ena's already super hyped about it, so let us know, okay♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hey, I was gonna tell her about that!
Anyway, Airi, happy birthday. I want to throw a real party for you, so please, if you're free! I beg you!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Momoi.
I know Ena's already a handful and this business about a party's probably gonna be a huge... Ow!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Airi! Thanks for being such a great dance teacher! I was so happy when you told me that I'd improved so much! I promise to keep trying my best!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Your experience with variety shows is so vital to making our streams fun and exciting. Happy birthday. We'll be counting on you moving forward.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Airi!
Our cake turned out well and we got to celebrate with our fans. I couldn't be happier for you.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I know we still have a lot to do for our next event, but let's keep doing our best as we work with our fans!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for joining me today to celebrate my birthday, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Given that our first real-life event succeeded, it feels like we're actually back on track as idols now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're still not sure when our next event's gonna be, but we promise to make it something spectacular!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we're gonna need your support to make that a reality, so we'll be counting on you guys moving forward!
